textos.As visões sobre o filme compartilham a a: The views on the film analyze the same elements and diverge in their assessment of how well it works. Most of those who reject it criticize the lack of likability and charisma of the characters in the script, while about half of those who recommend it highlight Leonardo DiCaprio's work on screen.
textos.Várias pessoas reclamam que o filme dura: Several people complain that the film runs nearly three hours and that, after the first hour, the repetition of parties and excess makes the narrative lose steam and become tiring.
textos.Excesso de cenas de sexo, nudez e drogas: Excess of sex scenes, nudity and drugs
textos.Este grupo considera que a quantidade de: This group considers the amount of explicit sex scenes, nudity and drug use unnecessary and finds it makes the experience uncomfortable and in poor taste.
textos.Glorificação do protagonista em vez de c: Glorification of the protagonist instead of criticism
textos.Diversos espectadores sentem que o filme: Several viewers feel the film portrays the protagonist's luxurious, criminal life in an attractive way, failing to condemn his acts and ending up romanticizing the behavior it should satirize.
textos.Muitas reviews afirmam que é difícil se: Many reviews state that it is hard to care about the protagonist or the other characters, all seen as unpleasant, selfish or empty, which hurts engagement with the story.
textos.Atuações elogiadas, mas insuficientes pa: Praised performances, but not enough to save the film
textos.Mesmo reconhecendo o talento do elenco,: Even while acknowledging the cast's talent, especially DiCaprio's, many say the good performances do not make up for the weak script or the general discomfort with the work.
textos.Tratamento sexista e objetificação femin: Sexist treatment and objectification of women
textos.Algumas pessoas criticam a forma como as: Some people criticize the way women are portrayed, reduced to sexual objects, and consider the film misogynistic and uncomfortable in this respect.
textos.Representação excessiva de drogas, sexo: Excessive depiction of drugs, sex and nudity
textos.Muitas reviews medianas consideram que o: Many middling reviews consider that the film overdoes scenes of nudity, sex and drug use, which feel gratuitous and repetitive, adding nothing to the story, making the experience uncomfortable or cheap.
textos.Este grupo destaca que, apesar de alguma: This group highlights that, despite some engaging sequences, the film stretches to three hours and could be shortened, since the pace becomes repetitive and tiring after a certain point.
textos.As reviews medianas elogiam a atuação de: Middling reviews praise Leonardo DiCaprio's performance and Martin Scorsese's direction, describing the execution as impeccable and able to hold interest even when the content is unpleasant.
textos.Romantização e glorificação de comportam: Romanticization and glorification of condemnable behavior
textos.Várias reviews apontam que o filme parec: Several reviews point out that the film seems to romanticize greed, drug use and the criminal lifestyle, without offering a sufficiently clear moral critique, which bothers a portion of the audience.
textos.Misoginia, objetificação e falta de prof: Misogyny, objectification and lack of depth
textos.Algumas reviews medianas criticam a form: Some middling reviews criticize the way women are portrayed in the film, reduced to sexual objects, and consider that this reflects a structural misogyny that makes the work uncomfortable and empty in its message.
textos.Certas reviews mencionam que o desfecho: Certain reviews mention that the ending brings no significant consequences for the protagonist or leaves the narrative without a coherent close, which causes frustration.
textos.Muitas reviews destacam a performance de: Many reviews highlight Leonardo DiCaprio's performance as one of the high points, describing it as intense, charismatic and possibly one of the best of his career.
textos.As reviews mencionam o retrato do excess: Reviews mention the portrayal of excess, with parties, drugs and money, which makes the film both engaging and repetitive at certain moments.
textos.A direção de Scorsese é frequentemente e: Scorsese's direction is often praised for keeping the pace fast and turning an excessive story into a striking cinematic experience.
textos.A longa duração é um ponto recorrente, c: The long running time is a recurring point, with some viewers feeling the film could be leaner, although many still consider it entertaining from start to finish.
textos.Várias análises interpretam o filme como: Several analyses interpret the film as a satire of unbridled capitalism and the culture of greed, warning against the glorification of these behaviors.
textos.A atuação de Margot Robbie é elogiada, c: Margot Robbie's performance is praised, with emphasis on the strength of her character, who is not just an accessory in the story.

textos.Dirigido por Martin Scorsese e lançado e: Directed by Martin Scorsese and released in 2013, The Wolf of Wall Street combines drama, comedy and crime in a 180-minute narrative. The plot portrays the trajectory of ambitious brokers who found a firm focused on low-value securities, getting rich quickly and establishing a routine entirely devoted to material pleasures.
textos.A experiência de assistir à obra é carac: The experience of watching the work is characterized by an extended time structure and a dense atmosphere, permeated by a continuous succession of parties, substance use and situations of immoderate opulence. The pace sustains this intense setting throughout the running time.
textos.Os diferentes grupos avaliam os mesmos e: The different groups assess the same elements of the film, diverging in their verdict and not in the subjects addressed. In the vast majority of ratings (~82%), Leonardo DiCaprio's performance is highlighted by a large portion of the analyses. In addition, a good portion emphasize the portrayal of excess and hedonism, while several stress the handling of Martin Scorsese's direction.
textos.Para quem se encontra numa fração mínima: For those in a minimal fraction of the ratings (~14%), about half criticize the excessive depiction of drugs, sex and nudity. In the same range, a significant share complain of the excessive running time and drawn-out pace, although a considerable number acknowledge the top-level technical performances and direction.
textos.Já para os avaliadores situados numa fra: For the reviewers in an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~4%), many are bothered by the excessive running time and drawn-out pace. Likewise, several disapprove of the excess of sex scenes, nudity and drugs, while a considerable number point to the glorification of the protagonist instead of criticism.
